title: Customization shortcuts (Agents sidebar)
description: Agents sidebar Customizations navigation. The top variant renders the current New Session, Automations, Customizations, and Sessions controls; the default preserves the legacy expanded shortcut list.
usage: Bottom of the Agents window sessions sidebar (280px wide). Listen for `open-customizations` to open <vsc-customizations-editor> on that section.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Active shortcut in the legacy expanded list.

attributes.name: counts
attributes.description: Comma-separated counts for Plugins through Tools in the legacy expanded list.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Use top for the current Agents sidebar actions and Sessions toolbar.

attributes.name: updates-available
attributes.description: Shows the yellow update indicator beside Customizations in the top variant.

states.name: open
states.trigger: Click a link: fires `open-customizations` with the section (Overview → browse).

states.name: active
states.trigger: `active` highlights the link of the open section (prototype affordance; the product doesn't track it).

variants.name: top
variants.description: Current top-of-sidebar navigation and Sessions toolbar.
